accepted.evidence: Turner 540 explicitly lists Shumashti awata adjective/substantive “hungry” under abhukta, while noting a possible alternative ábhakta source. Buddruss avata matches the attested local form; this assignment does not settle Turner’s deeper alternative. Exact manually collated source row and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 3906 explicitly lists Shumashti xurem “my foot” under khura. Buddruss independent xur “foot” has the same nominal stem without the possessor suffix. Exact manually collated source row and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
